blind.table_distance_name: stack of logs in a wooden frame
blind.description: A low, rectangular stack of small cut logs or pit props held together by light brown wooden framing braces. The bundle consists of tightly packed horizontal timber logs with bark and cut wood cross-sections visible at the ends. Three wooden battens clamp across the top and down the sides with square posts at the corners. Surfaces are solid and smoothly stylized with hand-painted wood grain textures; there are no floating elements, tears, or holes.
blind.from_above: A rectangular block of horizontal parallel logs banded across by three transverse wooden slats, with square wooden post tops visible at the four corners.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2 to 2.5 ft tall (reaching around knee-to-thigh height of the 5 ft 9 in figure), and roughly 4.5 to 5 ft long.
